Article title: Making sure you're not a bot!

Article text:
Anubis could not load its JavaScript. The server may be overloaded. Please reload the page to try again.
You are seeing this because the administrator of this website has set up Anubis to protect the server against the scourge of AI companies aggressively scraping websites. This can and does cause downtime for the websites, which makes their resources inaccessible for everyone.
Anubis is a compromise. Anubis uses a Proof-of-Work scheme in the vein of Hashcash, a proposed proof-of-work scheme for reducing email spam. The idea is that at individual scales the additional load is ignorable, but at mass scraper levels it adds up and makes scraping much more expensive.

Description: The failures we met putting large language models through the production of intelligence reports, the controls we built in response, and what we learned testing them.

Article text:
Building an AI harness for intelligence analysis
The failures we met putting large language models through the production of intelligence reports, the controls we built in response, and what we learned from testing them.
Large language models can produce convincing intelligence reports. They can search for information, read documents, extract facts, identify connections and turn large volumes of material into structured assessments. What they cannot reliably do on their own is demonstrate that every finding is supported by evidence, that every relevant source was actually examined, or that the process used to reach a conclusion was followed…
